en: A vintage illustrated postcard featuring a black‑ink portrait drawing of a bald man with a thick beard and mustache on a beige background. At the top there is Bulgarian text in Cyrillic, and below the portrait there is the person's name in a decorative script along with additional printed text giving a date (1809) and a note about his role in the enlightenment/education of the town of Stara Zagora.
